focus: Universal approximation property with 1 hidden layer
Skip layer neural network: direct connections between inputs and output
Every neuron has a bias input (intercept in linear regression)
text:
Multilayer Perceptron
Multiple hidden layers possible
Universal approximation property with 1 hidden layer
No feedback connections (recurrent networks) !
Skip layer neural network: direct connections between inputs and output
Every neuron has a bias input (intercept in linear regression)
Combination functions
Linear: linear combination of incoming values and weights (default)
Additive: adds all incoming values without using weights or biases
Equal slopes: same weights for each neuron per layer with different biases
Activation functions: cf. infra
MLPs are the most common type of neural network for supervised prediction in decision support
systems, for example, in credit scoring, churn prediction, response modeling, etc.
18 Data Science for Business

组合函数
线性: 输入值和权重的线性组合( 默认)

Avoiding overfitting using regularization
Bartlett (1997) demonstrated that generalization depends more on the size
of the weights than the number of weights
A large network with small weights acts like a smaller, less complex network
Thus, restraining the weights should prevent a bumpy overfitted surface
However, it might also prevent the model from adapting to true features of
the data
Penalize large weights (in absolute sense) in the objective function!

title: Avoiding overfitting using input selection with pruning
plain: 这一页的主题是「Avoiding overfitting using input selection with pruning」。这页主要靠图传递信息。先找标题、横纵轴、颜色和箭头，再用一句话说清楚谁变大时谁会怎样。
plainEn: This slide is about “Avoiding overfitting using input selection with pruning”. Read the title, axes, colors and arrows, then describe the main relationship in one sentence.
focus: Complicated in neural networks because each input is associated with h
input-to-hidden layer weights and h hidden-to-output layer weights
However, if all input-to-hidden layer weights for an input are zero (or close),
then the input is clearly not important
text:
Avoiding overfitting using input selection with pruning
Input selection = variable selection (cf. regression)
Complicated in neural networks because each input is associated with h
input-to-hidden layer weights and h hidden-to-output layer weights
However, if all input-to-hidden layer weights for an input are zero (or close),
then the input is clearly not important
Pruning algorithm:
Train the neural network
Prune the input where the input-to-hidden layer weights are closest to zero
Retrain the network (might be starting from previous weights to speed up convergence)
If the predictive power increases (or stays the same), then repeat.
If not, reconnect the input and stop
41 Data Science for Business
translation:
避免使用 pruning 的输入选择进行过度匹配
输入选择 = 变量选择(参见回归)
神经网络复杂,因为每个输入都与h相关
输入至隐藏层重量和 h 隐藏至输出层重量
然而,如果一个输入的所有输入到隐藏层的权重为零(或接近),
那么输入显然不重要
运行算法 :
训练神经网络
将输入至隐藏层加权数最接近于零的输入
重新训练网络(可能从以前的权重开始,以加速趋同)
如果预测功率增加(或保持不变),则重复.
如果没有,请重新连接输入并停止

text:
Avoiding overfitting using input selection with a
wrapper approach
1. Start from a neural network with all n inputs.
2. Remove each input in turn and re-estimate the network.
3. Exclude the input whose absence gives the best performing network (for
example, in terms of AUC, MSE, …).
4. Repeat this procedure until performance decreases significantly
